claim: The Operational Excellence Pillar (OPS08-BP04) says basing alerts on KPIs ensures that the signals you receive are directly tied to business or operational impact; setting up too many non-critical alerts leads to alert fatigue, and a benefit of the practice is reduced alert fatigue by focusing on actionable and relevant alerts.

evidence.quote: Basing alerts on KPIs ensures that the signals you receive are directly tied to business or operational impact.
Setting up too many non-critical alerts, leading to alert fatigue.
Reduced alert fatigue by focusing on actionable and relevant alerts.
